title: Candles: hour, day, week, month and year
description: OHLC candles for every supported period (hour, day, week, month, year) of one pair and source, from the InfluxDB ohlc measurement (README "Dashboards").

list.name: pair
list.label: Pair
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "prices", tag: "pair", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc", start: -11y)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "prices", tag: "pair", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc", start: -11y)

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.description: index: the cross-exchange median of last prices; or one exchange's last price.
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "prices", tag: "source", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc", start: -11y)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "prices", tag: "source", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc", start: -11y)

panels.title: Current candle of each period
panels.description: The latest candle per period. complete = false: still in progress (upserted every mds.ohlc.flush-interval). updates = 0: carried forward, no price in this period yet.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "prices")
  |> range(start: -11y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc" and r.pair == "${pair}" and r.source == "${source}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "open" or r._field == "high" or r._field == "low" or r._field == "close" or r._field == "updates" or r._field == "complete")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "period"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with order: if r.period == "hour" then 0 else if r.period == "day" then 1 else if r.period == "week" then 2 else if r.period == "month" then 3 else 4}))
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])
  |> keep(columns: ["period", "_time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "updates", "complete"])

panels.title: Hour candles
panels.description: One candle per hour, timestamped at the period start (in mds.ohlc.zone: the local hour, or midnight for days and longer). The current one is in progress; flat candles (open = high = low = close) were carried forward through a period without prices (README "OHLC candles").

targets.query:
from(bucket: "prices")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ohlc" and r.pair == "${pair}" and r.source == "${source}" and r.period == "hour")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "open" or r._field == "high" or r._field == "low" or r._field == "close")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "open", "high", "low", "close"])
